definitions: An acronym for 'Business Social Responsibility', referring to a company's commitment to ethical and sustainable practices.
An acronym for 'Broadcasting Satellite for Radio', a type of satellite used for radio broadcasting.
An acronym for 'Body Stress Release', a health technique that aims to release stored tension in the body.
examples: Many companies are focusing on BSR initiatives.
The new BSR system will improve radio reception.
She sought BSR for her chronic back pain.
